productFit.name: Sunwayfoto ET-01 Carbon Fiber Tripod Extension Tube (reference row in the spec table; not a product block)
productFit.metricSpecs: Keep the English B&H figures converted: 30 cm (12 in) extra, 19 cm (7.4 in) folded, 116 g (4.1 oz), 10 kg (22 lb).
productFit.reason: Sold worldwide through the maker's own international store (sunwayfoto.com) under the same ET-01 code; no local-availability claim in the post.

productFit.name: Benro carbon fiber extension column (reference row; not a product block)
productFit.metricSpecs: Benro gives the metric figure itself: extends to a maximum of 16 inches (40.5 cm).
productFit.reason: Only Benro USA pages found for the extension columns; no EU dealer page checked. Not a product block, so no note is needed; no availability claim in the post.

productFit.name: Manfrotto MT055XPRO3 (example tripod in the height calculation)
productFit.metricSpecs: Manfrotto global-de: 140 cm with the centre column down, 170 cm max (matches B&H 55 in).
productFit.reason: Sold in the EU under the same code (Manfrotto German maker page).

localFacts.fact: Benro gives the extension column's metric maximum itself: 16 inches (40,5 cm).
Manfrotto's spec sheet: MT055XPRO3 140 cm with the column down, 170 cm max (the post's 55 in example).
Spanish terms: columna de extensión / alargador de columna / extensor (extension column), columna central, cabeza del trípode, rosca de 1/4" y 3/8".

localPainPoints.pain: Spanish birders note the Manfrotto 055 is very stable only as long as the centre column stays down.
localPainPoints.fix: The post's 055 example: 140 cm legs-only; an extension column adds the same weakness as a raised column, so use it only for small gaps.

quotes.text: El 055 es muy buen trípode en cuanto a estabilidad (siempre que no saques la columna central)

localPainPoints.note: Quote from the Firecrawl search excerpt at that URL.

localPainPoints.pain: The centre column adds a lot of instability; touching the camera lightly shows movement.
localPainPoints.fix: Extend legs first, column last, hang a bag low and fire with a self-timer.

localPainPoints.note: Quote from the Firecrawl search excerpt at that URL.
